events.hypothesis: This program constructs a non-Gaussian polynomial kernel candidate by combining the quartic source program with specific monomial modes (0 and 3) from chart_2. It applies endpoint marks to the raw source jets, then sews the adjoint of the constructed kernel back into the marked source. This attempts to close the gap between the abstract source dictionary and the physical endpoint operators by enforcing a specific polynomial structure on the even Grassmann components.
events.proposed_origin_argument: The argument rests on the invariance of the even Grassmann sector under the specific monomial masks 0 and 3, as identified in the retained chart. If the original source U/Y binding preserves this even parity structure, then the polynomial kernel constructed from these modes should align with the physical weight distribution. The sewing operation attempts to enforce this alignment by projecting the adjoint kernel onto the marked source space, effectively testing the hypothesis that the non-Gaussian terms are supported on these specific modes.

events.title: Bereits geprüfte Konstruktion wiederholt
events.description: Der Vorschlag bringt keinen neuen geprüften Quellenkern.
events.error: ValueError: Repeated already evaluated program. Propose an actually different operator, not the chart_2/chart_4 quartic template. For example use exact native.sew or construct a new full even polynomial kernel. Rewriting the origin prose is not a new program.
events.hypothesis: This program constructs a WholeSourceCandidate from the chart_4 mode space using the quartic source program derived from c3 and c6_ratio. It assumes the nil_action of this quartic program provides the necessary EvenSourceOperator for jet extraction.
events.proposed_origin_argument: The argument is that the quartic source program, when acted upon by the nil_action, generates a source operator whose jets, when evaluated against the whole source dictionary, yield a candidate that satisfies the Pi-invariance condition derived in finding:triangulation20261106o-actual-selector-word-and-equivalent-boson-sign-test. Specifically, the vanishing of opposite LEFT-parity blocks is enforced by the structure of the quartic kernel.

events.hypothesis: Construct a new full even polynomial kernel using a combination of different monomials from the chart_4 masks.
events.proposed_origin_argument: The new polynomial kernel can be derived by combining different monomials from the chart_4 masks with appropriate coefficients. This can be done by using the native.monomial operation to create individual monomials and then combining them using native.kernel_add. The coefficients can be chosen based on the physical requirements of the problem, such as symmetry and conservation laws. This approach allows for the construction of a more complex and potentially more accurate kernel than the previous quartic template.

boundary.detail: The current registry constructs finite even-kernel hypotheses and actual four values. It does not synthesize trusted original-identity/time/continuum/T1..T8 proofs. Such derivation proposals are recorded for original-source review, never admitted by self-attestation.
